:''For the human character who also goes by this nickname in [[The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero]], see [[Kieran]].'' ---- {{AnimePokémonInfobox |nickname=Kiki |jnickname=COCO |tmnickname=Coco |image=[[File:Kiki.png|200px]] |caption=Ruby's Delcatty |location=Unknown |gender=Female |nature=Naive |ability={{a|Cute Charm}} |type1=Normal |media=special |evolution=1 |epnum=PS181 |numeps1=13 |firststagename=Skitty |secondstagename=Delcatty |epname=Creeping Past Cacnea |firstevoep=PS194 |firstevoname=Guile from Mawile |prevonum=300 |evo1num=301 |pokemonname=Delcatty |current=[[Party|With Ruby]] |va=no }} '''Kiki''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|COCO|ココ}}'''), known as '''Coco''' in [[Chuang Yi]]'s translations, is a {{p|Delcatty}} that {{adv|Ruby}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and one of his [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]]. Kiki was given to Ruby by his father, {{adv|Norman}}. She is [[level]] 68, her [[Characteristic]] is that she "scatters things often", and she is used in {{OBP|Cute|condition}} {{pkmn|Contest}}s. ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}=== Prior to the start of the manga, Kiki was given to {{adv|Ruby}} as a Skitty as a {{pkmn2|gift}} from his father, {{adv|Norman}}. One day, when Ruby was playing with {{adv|Sapphire}}, a {{TP|Zinnia|Salamence}} attacked them and Ruby sent out Kiki, [[Nana]], and [[Rara]] to fend it off. The three managed to scare it away, but Ruby got injured in the process, which scared Sapphire. Because of this incident, Ruby decided to never battle in front of people again. Before moving to [[Hoenn]], Kiki was used by Ruby to win multiple contests in [[Johto]]. Kiki first appeared as a Skitty in ''[[PS181|Creeping Past Cacnea]]'', where she was seen with Ruby on his trip to Hoenn. [[PS186|After]] running away from home, Ruby was almost caught by his father while he was helping {{adv|Wally}} catch a Pokémon, but was saved by Kiki's {{m|Safeguard}}. [[File:Kiki Cute Charm effect.png|thumb|100px|left|Activating Cute Charm as a Skitty]] In ''[[PS193|Stick This in Your Craw, Crawdaunt! II]]'', Kiki was sent out when a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Crawdaunt}} attacked [[Mr. Briney]]. His [[Peeko]] was unable to battle after her beak was shattered due to Crawdaunt's {{a|Shell Armor}} [[Ability]]. After Mr. Briney passed out, Kiki was able to defeat the Crawdaunt by spinning around to avoid damage and increase the chance of activating her {{a|Cute Charm}} Ability. After Crawdaunt was infatuated, Kiki slammed into it with a {{m|Double-Edge}}. In ''[[PS194|Guile from Mawile]]'', Ruby went into [[Granite Cave]] in order to find a {{p|Milotic}}. During the trip, he is attacked by a group of {{p|Mawile}} and in the fight Kiki and Nana both [[Evolution|evolve]]. In ''[[PS209|Hanging Around With Slaking I]]'', Kiki fought alongside Nana against Norman and his {{TP|Norman|Slaking}} and {{p|Vigoroth}}. Nana fired a {{m|Hyper Beam}} while Kiki attacked with {{m|Iron Tail}}. Despite their strength, Kiki and Nana were easily swept away due to the fact that Norman knew all of Ruby's strategies, as he was the one to teach them to him. [[File:Ruby Super Rank Ribbons Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Kiki earning the Super Ribbon]] In ''[[PS217|Mind-Boggling with Medicham]]'', Kiki advanced Ruby through the [[Rank (Contest)|Normal Rank]] of the Cuteness Contest. In ''[[PS220|Going to Eleven with Loudred and Exploud I]]'', Kiki is used alongside Ruby's other Pokémon to battle against [[Courtney]] and her {{p|Ninetales}}. Although Ruby had a five-to-one advantage, his team was beaten due to Ninetales having control of nine different fireballs. In ''[[PS223|I More Than Like You, Luvdisc I]]'', Kiki advanced Ruby through the Super Rank of the Cuteness Contest. After the contest, Kiki is used in Ruby's battle against [[Wallace]] alongside the rest of his team, bar [[Feefee]], and loses. In ''[[PS232|Always Keep Whiscash on You for Emergencies]]'', Kiki advanced Ruby through the Hyper Rank of the Cuteness Contest. In ''[[PS248|The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon X]]'', Kiki, alongside Ruby and Sapphire's other Pokémon, are used to battle against [[Archie]] and [[Maxie]]. Kiki was seen charging at Maxie's {{p|Camerupt}}, but was pushed back by {{m|Overheat}}. In ''[[PS267|It All Ends Now VIII]]'', Kiki battled alongside the rest of Ruby and Sapphire's Pokémon against Maxie and Archie. Later that day, Kiki is shown to have won the Master Rank of the Cuteness Contest, wearing a [[Pink Scarf]]. ==={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}=== In ''[[PS603|Slowbro Has an Idea]]'', Kiki appeared alongside the rest of Ruby's team when he was checking to make sure they all survived the crash caused by the [[Draconid people]]. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Ruby and Kiki.png|thumb|200px|Kiki and Ruby]] Kiki has shown to have a naive and innocent personality, and as a Skitty, was a little ditsy. Much like {{adv|Ruby}}, she is flashy, loves to show off her looks, and hates getting dirty. Despite Ruby's distaste for battling, Kiki is a very powerful battler. She has also been shown to get seasick and has a habit of chasing her tail. {{-}} ==Appearance== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{normal color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{normal color dark}}" |- !
